name: Crowded-long fragility fade — high funding + OI expansion + RSI overbought (short, 4h)
rationale: MECHANISM: the crowded-long fragility thesis read through momentum-exhaustion (RSI) rather than mean-distance. High funding_rate (top decile) + EXPANDING open_interest is a crowded, carry-bleeding long book; RSI overbought says the buying impulse is spent. We short (direction -1) the exhaustion and receive the positive funding carry (funding_feature). Distinct from variants 04/05: RSI is a momentum gauge, not a band/range distance, and the exit is on RSI reverting toward neutral, giving a different trade population and hold profile. DISCONFIRMER 1: kill if dropping the OI-expansion arm leaves the same edge — then it is a naive RSI-overbought short into a high-funding uptrend that gets run over. DISCONFIRMER 2: kill if it is indistinguishable from a plain RSI-overbought short with no funding condition, or if maxDD > 25% from being early on the crowded side.
catalyst: high funding + rising open interest + RSI overbought — crowded, exhausted longs to fade short.
